certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Shapes and Patterns (Ages 5-7)

learning_outcomes.text: Name common 2D shapes such as circle, square, triangle and rectangle
Describe shapes by their sides and corners
Recognise and name simple 3D shapes such as cube, sphere and cylinder
Copy, continue and create repeating patterns
Sort shapes by a chosen property
Find shapes in everyday objects around them

integrative_case: Design a patterned border for the classroom wall by choosing shapes and colours, repeating them in a rule, and checking the pattern carries on correctly all the way around the room.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
